_comment: The gate's rules. Different case kinds get different bars.
_require_rubric_approval: Governance, not statistics: was the judge's rubric signed off by real human reviewers? Needs 30+ human-reviewed cases and two named reviewers of different roles. The shipped file is a TEMPLATE that fails on purpose - turn this on once you have genuine sign-off.
_metric: pass^k - a case counts only if EVERY trial passed.
_use_ci_lower: Judge on the LOWER end of the confidence interval instead of the raw number. Correct, but needs ~60+ cases to ever pass. Turn on when the suite is big enough.
